title: SIDESTORY: STULTIFERA NAVIS RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: STULTIFERA NAVIS RERUN
EVENT DURATION: November 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 12, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Stultifera Navis event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Gran Faro] Duration: November 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 8, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Lost Flagship] Duration: November 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 8, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Nameless Ocean] Duration: November 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 8, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Dusty Picturebook] Duration: November 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 8, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Mirror Image] Duration: November 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 8, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[GRAN FARO] [LOST FLAGSHIP] [NAMELESS OCEAN]
DETAILS: During the event, players can explore the event map, clear event stage, complete specific events and unlock chests to gain event rewards.
MAIN REWARDS:
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Shore Rescue Modification - Lancet-2,
Stultifera Navis Reception Room Furniture (Pieces),
Rusted Compass
[BITTERSCALE TAVERN]
DURATION: November 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 12, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Rusted Compass. Rusted Compass can be used to redeem items.
MAIN REWARDS: Lumen's Token, Stultifera Navis Reception Room Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Intermezzi].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.
- During the rerun, the event entry in [Intermezzi] will be changed to the rerun event entry, and it will be restored after the Rerun ends.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
- [Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
- Operators Specter the Unchained, Irene, Lumen, and Windflit will gain more trust during the event rerun.
